[[keys.command]] key = "prefix+c" type = "shell" command = '"${HERDR_BIN_PATH:-herdr}" plugin pane open --plugin commandcode.integration --entrypoint task --focus' description = "Command Code: new task" EOF echo "===CHECK==="; herdr config check 2>&1 | head; echo "===RELOAD==="; herdr server reload-config 2>&1 | head)
